notes.title: Nightly Maintenance Full Release… for real this time
notes.content:
[h1]BIG NEWS![/h1]

Attention players! The full release of Nightly Maintenance is here! Do note that at this time, I’ve removed cut content and did not include an epilogue. Take a look at the milestones of Nightly Maintenance!

[h2]Development begins - December 2021[/h2]

[h2]Itch.io Release - April 2022[/h2]

[h2]Nightmare mode is released (0.3.0)[/h2]

[h2]Steam Version releases[/h2]
[list]
[*]Switch to HDRP Render Pipeline for better lighting and HD graphics
[/list]
[h2]6/29/2022- 0.4.0 releases[/h2]
[list]
[*]Hallucinations get added
[*]Yellow Machine & Task is added
[*]Green Machine & Task is added
[/list]
[h2]8/23/2022 - 0.5.0 releases[/h2]
[list]
[*]Item Store comes out to aid in the night
[*]Economy is added
[/list]
[h2]3/27/2023 - 0.6.0 releases[/h2]
[list]
[*]The “house” menu is added removing the old UI menu
[*]Steam Achievements are added
[*] User flairs for beta testers and content creators
[*]Brown Mannequin is added with chase animations
[/list]
[h2]8/16/2023 - 0.7.0 is released[/h2]
[list]
[*]Factory gets expanded
[*]Mannequin Capsule & task
[*]Power box & task
[*]Radio and task
[/list]
[h2]12/2/2023 - FULL RELEASE[/h2]
Everything is cleaned up for production!

[h1]And that’s not all… You’ve been promoted![/h1]
Development of a spin-off has begun where YOU get to manage your own factory! Come all real-time tycoon mystery enthusiasts for a new project where you will be able to gain early access on Itch.io for a small fee of $4.99 once development finishes

notes.title: APRIL FOOLS PATCH NOTES - Nightly Maintenance 1.0!!!
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a new task where you have to find and feed a stray cat that has somehow wandered into the factory.
[*] Added a new sound effect for when players successfully complete a task: a round of applause from the mannequin.
[*] Added a new mini-game where you have to play "Simon Says" with the mannequin. It's harder than it sounds.
[*] The flashlight now has a disco mode, which makes it flash different colors and play funky music.
[*] The mannequin will occasionally wear a party hat and blow a kazoo, just to celebrate your progress.
[*]Added a new "Jumpscare" difficulty mode for players who want an extra challenge.
[*]Introducing a new enemy - a giant sentient broom that will chase you down and clean you out of the factory.
[*]Added a new power-up that gives you temporary invincibility to the mannequin's stare.
[*]Added a new collectible - a rubber chicken - for players to find throughout the factory.
[*]Added a new task: "Fix the Unfixable" where players must repair broken objects with random items found in the factory. Good luck!
[*]Added a new game mode: "Mannequin's Revenge" where players play as the mannequin and must catch Malcom before he completes his tasks.
[*]Added a new item: "Pizza Cutter" which can be used as a weapon against the mannequin. Please note that the mannequin is not affected by pizza.
[*]Added a new easter egg: "The Abandoned Easter Basket" where players can find hidden Easter eggs scattered throughout the factory.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The mannequin will now occasionally break into song and dance routines, because why not?
[*] The mannequin's eyes will now follow your mouse cursor around the screen, just to keep you on your toes.
[*] The mannequin will occasionally wear a party hat and blow a kazoo, just to celebrate your progress.
[*]Replaced the mannequin's haunting gaze with a cute puppy-dog look to make it less scary.
[*]Reduced the number of tasks each night to two, because even maintenance workers need a break.
[*]Added a 10% chance for any task to be a dance-off with the mannequin, because who doesn't love a good dance-off?
[*]Replaced the creepy music with 80s synth-pop to lighten the mood.
[*]The game will now take place in space because I accidentally deleted the factory asset and can't get it back
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players were unable to order a pepperoni pizza, even though they clearly specified it in the task.
[*] Fixed a bug where the pallets in the factory were actually just giant marshmallows in disguise. Sorry for the confusion!
[*] Fixed a bug where players were able to glitch through walls and discover a secret disco room. That's for the sequel!
[*]Fixed an issue where the mannequin would sometimes break the fourth wall and offer players life advice.
[*]Fixed an issue where Malcom would sometimes turn into a giant pizza after being caught by the mannequin.
[*]Fixed an issue where players would sometimes get stuck in a never-ending loop of ordering pizza.
[*]Fixed an issue where the factory's backstory would randomly change every time the game was played.
[*]Fixed an issue where the mannequin would occasionally start singing showtunes instead of chasing Malcom.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would crash if players tried to use the "Pizza Cutter" on the mannequin (turns out the mannequin is immune to pizza-related weapons).
[/list]

Enjoy and April Fools :)

notes.title: Quality of Life/Steam Update: Version 0.3.2
notes.content:
Dear Malcom,

The game is now on steam so it's time we bring some Quality of Life Updates to make it worthy of this opportunity

First take notes of the controls:
[h2]Controls[/h2]
Move - WASD

Look - Mouse

Interact - E

Pizza Order - F

[url=https://discord.gg/UYYuRejxrN]Join the Discord[/url]

---------------------------------------------------------

Here are some changes we made:

[h2]New[/h2]
Added some previously unused assets

Shadows for all lights except where it'd look stupid

Added Settings Menu

The mannequin is wearing a party hat to celebrate the Steam release

Added direct link to Trello board from main menu

Added direct link to the NEW Discord Server from main menu

[h2]Changes[/h2]
The game will now pause the round when focus is lost (Like Alt-tabbing or using Win + D)

Changed one of the loading screen text referring to not touching the mannequin as it was no longer true (It's been replaced with a better one ːsteamthumbsupː)

Looking up and down is now enabled again

Switched to a better render pipeline (Send a report if you notice any pink textures)

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Fixed a bug where clicking "Quit to Menu" from the pause menu would cause no animations or music to play on the main menu

Fixed lights being different intensities

Fixed a bug where Quit to Desktop didn't work on Quickplay

Fixed a bug where Quit to Desktop didn't show at all on Nightmare



Thank you,

Eve

Mannequins LLC
